important_interpretation: The FROZEN_INDEPENDENT constraint graph is a COMPUTATION graph. Edges scenario_proposal->eligibility->conception->gestation->birth encode viability computation/forecast, NOT V3 causal parent refs, real events, or the ADP020 selection permission. The solver never emits an admitted conception or birth.

represented_causal_graph_PROSPECTIVE_NOT.owner_condition: Each IF_ISSUED edge is conditional, not currently admitted and not an automatic effect of its predecessor. Child birth and CHILD_GENERATED are separate semantics; scheduling relationship between them remains issuer-owned.
